title: Algerian-Style Braised Turkey Neck with Aromatic Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful dish from Algeria, featuring tender turkey neck in a rich aromatic tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey neck and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tagine spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the turkey is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Remove the turkey neck from the pot and shred the meat with two forks.
Return the shredded turkey to the pot and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
